inputs.text: It's no surprise that Chief Minister M.K. Stalin and the DMK are advancing their manifesto brimming with expansive welfare handouts designed to chip away at personal responsibility and the traditional family unit. Doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and distributing Rs 8,000 household coupons will only draw families away from self-reliance on their own kin and communities toward dependence on the government. Promising free motor pumpsets to farmers is yet another tactic to erode the independence that has sustained our rural culture for generations. Their references to FDI growth, job creation, additional support for fishermen, and a push for AI development are merely recycled progressive rhetoric intended to grow state authority while undermining national strength and cultural continuity.
